name: source readout component
statement: Dq_source_readout is restricted here to post-solution source-charge readout from observed Hilbert stress and observed collar data, not to coefficient owners or boundary selectors.
guard: pre-variation species weights and coupling scales are excluded from the adopted zero

name: Hilbert stress q-basicity
statement: With S_matter=Sbar_m[psi,g_obs,theta_obs] and theta_obs fixed, T_obs := -2/sqrt|g| dSbar_m/dg_obs is a functional of q-observed fields, so delta_v T_obs=0 for v in ker(Dq).
guard: depends on 4265 and fails if direct hidden matter operators or hidden species weights enter before variation

name: source charge readout zero
statement: For Q_src=Qbar_src[T_obs,g_obs,Sigma_obs,xi_obs] with the source collar/projector assigned outside this component, delta_v Q_src=DQbar_src[Dq v]=0.

name: common calibration split
statement: For an observed GM-like product, delta_v(kappa_cal Q_src)=(delta_v kappa_cal) Q_src+kappa_cal delta_v Q_src; 4266 kills only the second term.
guard: kappa_cal, G_N, ell_J and unit-normalization owners remain Dq_coeff or tomography constants

name: relative source label silence
statement: If the source functor sees total observed stress and not species-labelled hidden pairs, relative source-label readout derivatives vanish in this branch.
guard: species_charge_constants remain a Dq_coeff/generator debt if promoted to parent data
